editorial.blurb: A beloved family-run gem serving authentic Mexican food made fresh to order, from handmade tortillas to traditional birria that tastes like abuelita's kitchen.
editorial.insiderTip: Sit at the traditional Mexican-style lunch counter to watch your food being made fresh in front of you—it's the heart of the experience.

topDishes.note: Generous portions using the true traditional recipe, incredibly delicious and satisfying
Best in the city, made with handmade tortillas and authentic seasoning
Unbelievably fresh and flavorful, exceptional quality for the price
